findings.title: Deprecation warning is silently skipped when both fields are set. The warning only fires `if (clientConfig?.strategy && !clientConfig.authStrategy)`.
findings.label: incorrect
findings.note: At head the warning fires whenever clientConfig.strategy is set (index.ts:864), even alongside authStrategy; the quoted `&& !authStrategy` condition does not exist.

findings.title: Mutual-exclusion error mentions `authStrategy` even when the deprecated `strategy` field caused it. `authStrategy` here is resolved as `cfg.authStrategy ?? cfg.
findings.label: incorrect
findings.note: At head, wasm-inline.ts:450 picks the field name ('authStrategy' vs 'strategy') for the error message, so the message names the deprecated field when only that one was set.
